title: JBL Headphones OTA configuration (observed)
description: Schema of the ota_config.json served for the JBL Wave Buds 2 (PID 2100), as observed via the companion app. The firmware record is the stable part; the surrounding envelope varied between responses (observed root/sibling keys: pid, name, firmware, tone; and a nested product { ..., case, case_v2, dongle, tone } form). Tools locate the firmware record by matching the firmware{version,md5,bin} shape next to a pid, rather than assuming a fixed path.

version.description: OTA release label (a separate namespace from the GATT firmware-version triple; see docs/03).

md5.description: MD5 of the entire packaged .bin; used by the app to verify the download. Not the internal container CRC-32 (see docs/02).

bin.description: Firmware filename. The download URL is reconstructed by the app from the Harman storage route + PID, so this must stay intact when the config is rewritten.

only_support_greater_than.description: Optional lower-bound gate checked by OTAUtil.hasOTAUpdate(); omitted in the captured config.

pid.description: Product id, e.g. 2100 for the Wave Buds 2.

tone.description: Voice-prompt/tone package record (structure not analyzed here).
